name: Council of Basel opens
summary: The last great conciliarist church council, convoked by Martin V and continued by Eugenius IV. Basel asserts the supremacy of general councils over popes and conducts negotiations with the Hussites and the Byzantine Church (transferred to Ferrara/Florence in 1437).

_quarry.structural_significance: High-water mark of the conciliarist movement; failure of Basel's claims against papal monarchy effectively ends the conciliar challenge to centralised papal authority.
